name: Artbees Quick View for WooCommerce
author: artbees

sections.description:
Artbees Quick View for WooCommerce adds a local quick-view modal for eligible WooCommerce products. It provides automatic loop triggers, a shortcode, and a dynamic block, plus a WooCommerce settings workspace for choosing launch, content, gallery, behavior, style, labels, and visibility defaults.

The modal reads product data from the same WordPress site and renders WooCommerce’s native product-type add-to-cart controls. Products that WooCommerce does not expose publicly are not returned by the public quick-view endpoint.

Privacy

Artbees Quick View for WooCommerce makes no plugin-scope external requests and stores no personal data. It uses local WordPress options and product/category metadata only. The product endpoint is served by the same site and uses no third-party analytics, fonts, tracking pixels, remote executable code, or payment service.
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate WooCommerce.
  2. Upload and activate Artbees Quick View for WooCommerce.
  3. Open Artbees → Quick View and complete Setup.
  4. Review Settings, then save the complete settings document.

Use [artbees_qv] for a manual trigger, or add the Quick View block in the editor. The public product endpoint is intended for Artbees Quick View for WooCommerce’s own local modal runtime; it returns only publicly visible WooCommerce products.
sections.faq:
Does Artbees Quick View for WooCommerce send data to another service?

No. The Free plugin makes no plugin-scope external network requests and does not collect telemetry. See the Privacy section below.

What data is stored?

Artbees Quick View for WooCommerce stores its settings and product/category visibility overrides in this WordPress installation. It does not store customer, order, cart, or analytics data.

What happens on uninstall?

Data is retained by default. Enable the “remove data” lifecycle choice in Artbees Quick View for WooCommerce settings before uninstalling only if you want Artbees Quick View for WooCommerce’s own options, metadata, caches, and scheduled work removed. It never deletes WooCommerce products, orders, customers, or categories.

Is there a Pro add-on?

Artbees Quick View Pro is a separate companion plugin. It is not required for the Free plugin, which remains fully usable on its own.
